scope: Thirty-second diagnosis of current-road intent at the existing Jinan anchors
anchor_cohort: Vehicles on ordinary lanes with outgoing connections, at most 25 m from the lane end at the initial frame
arms: condition the first current-road draw on lane-compatible support including END
use the recorded route's next road for that same first draw
shared: Corrected stopline projection, recorded actual signals, frozen new LC and longitudinal coefficients, and identical boundary and vehicle random streams
decision: Compare each seed's two windows at 30 s. Progress to a training-only lane prior only if lane conditioning improves both controlled halt excess and absolute green-entry error on both seeds. Otherwise use the same short trajectories to isolate the dominant residual constraint.
conditional_calibration: If the short replay supports the lane prior, estimate it on the four original training seeds and run the frozen 450-second accuracy gates on new seeds 76116931 and 76116932. Keep the 30-second diagnostic separate from independent calibration.
storage: jtl110gpu2; keep vehicle records and per-run traces server-side
